svg.aria-label: Binary floating point rounds 0.1 + 0.2 to 0.30000000000000004. filament-exact adds the fractions 1/10 and 2/10 exactly and gets 3/10, and when an operation such as 1/2 divided by 0 has no value it returns undefined.
svg.title: Binary floating point rounds 0.1 + 0.2 to 0.30000000000000004. filament-exact adds the fractions 1/10 and 2/10 exactly and gets 3/10, and when an operation such as 1/2 divided by 0 has no value it returns undefined.
